sample: Public SPARQL endpoint, documented as a 5 percent sample. Counts are not multiplied by 20.
counting: One tweet is one observation for an entity. A second annotation of the same URI in that tweet is not a second observation. When two URIs are listed, their tweets are not added together.
series_rule: The series URI is the DBpedia URI aligned with the Wikidata English Wikipedia title when that URI has at least 14 days in the Phase 1C probe. Otherwise it is the URI the linker actually used. The other URI is recorded and is not part of the series.
mention_row_counts_are: Phase 1C probe totals before the one-tweet recount. They are not the Arm B series.
tesla_exclusion: Tesla is excluded from Arm B. The URIs below were tried. None of them changes the exclusion.

Apple CEO.note: Steve Jobs ends 2011-08-23, before the TweetsKB sample, so his URI adds no day. The series is Tim Cook, and every Cook day in the sample is inside his window.

also_linked.note: Not merged. The ticker item is Hewlett-Packard. HP Inc. is a different item and has fewer than 14 days.

arm_a.note: FNSPID has 0 rows for SSNLF, SMSN, and SSNGY. The Arm A news series is the headline alias.

also_linked.note: Not added to the Samsung series.

Samsung.note: Added beside Logitech after the 14-day coverage check. Logitech stays.

Microsoft CEO.note: Steve Ballmer ends 2014-02-04, before the TweetsKB sample, so his URI adds no day. The series is Satya Nadella, and every Nadella day in the sample is inside his window.

CRM.note: Salesforce.com was not queried. Salesforce returned tweets, so the series stops there.

also_linked.note: Historical name. Not added to Adobe_Inc. Adobe_Inc. itself has 21 days, which clears the 14-day bar.
Not added to the Google series. GOOG and GOOGL both resolve to Q95, not to Q20800404.

Android.note: No tried URI returned a tweet. Arm A still has the alias. Arm B social does not.

Alphabet CEO.note: One tweet counts once across both URIs inside the windows in configs/ceo_tenures.json. The two series are not summed. Eric Schmidt ends 2011-04-08, before the TweetsKB sample, so his URI adds no day. The union has 257 days and 393 tweets, from 2015-01-24 through 2020-11-25.

also_linked.note: The Wikidata English title is Meta Platforms. That URI returned 0 tweets, so the series uses Facebook. The two are not added.
Aligned with the Wikidata title and empty. The series uses Amazon.com. The two are not added.
Not the series. Snap_Inc. has 14 days, which meets the coverage bar, and it matches the Wikidata item. Snapchat is not added.

PINS.note: The ticker item Q96095585 has 1 sitelink and no English Wikipedia title. The search hit Q255381 is the well-known Pinterest item and is not the ticker item. The DBpedia series uses Pinterest and is not merged with Q96095585.

Tesla.exclusion_reason: The linker series for Tesla_Motors ends 2017-11-29. Tesla,_Inc. returned 0 tweets. The exclusion stands.
